满分10分给4 一开始玩demo觉得有点意思，可以选择抽攻击或防御卡，相信玩过杀戮尖塔2的人，只要体会过一回合手上全是攻击或者全是防御，体会过鬼抽的痛就会反应过来这是个天才设计，有点像是直接把牌堆摊开抓自己想打的牌打，可以只抓几张攻击牌然后每回合都抽攻击牌，这样就能复读战技 那有人就要问了，那这不是比塔2好多了么怎么才给4连及格分都没有 因为除了这一点其他基本全是缺点了 AI卡面，AI音乐，AI配音，任务又多战斗又慢，塔2好歹还有加速模式，这游戏干什么都要加载一下，黑下屏幕然后右下角转一圈图标，虽然也没个几秒钟，但是你每打一场战斗都要加载一下，一个章节下来要加载十几二十次了 然后还有一点，这玩意除了数值完全不平衡以外（这里是指玩家数值爆表，我已经测试过这游戏最强套装就是盗墓套加誓刃加深井坚韧护符，这一套什么强度呢，用杀戮尖塔的标准解释就是开局2敏11力，然后每场战斗结束回5血本局游戏永久加1力，我的天哪，每场战斗结束自动无上限举重吗，吓哭十兆战士哥，燃烧之血拉成啥了），死了还要掉一半圣灰，这是什么概念？你是魂游吗你死了就掉魂，人家无限机兵正儿八经玩宫崎英高倒模玩出来的正统魂游换上掉魂掉最狠的核心也就是掉40%魂，你比人家魂游的死亡惩罚还严重，虽然说角色开局有这个强度确实不容易死吧，但是前提是你有这个强度的装备，问题是前期哪里能搞到盗墓套？起码也得反复刷第三章，要么就做任务做到死，而且我说的是全部满3级装备的情况，没有满3级装备数值还拉一点，但也够平推了 那这就又涉及到一个问题：这游戏一共快10章地图，怎么我第三章能拿到的装备就请输入文本了，而且还只是稀有度为蓝色的装备，后边一定还有更强力的装备吧？ 答案是没有，其他套装我都测试过，有反伤的但是抽牌少也走不动路，有打信仰流的但是这一套穿出去数值又不如盗墓套直接加力加得高，我感觉作者可能是想参考魂游的属性加点来对应增幅攻击卡的攻击力，但是平衡这一块确实拉完了。纯力量流有一张白卡，在攻击卡之后打出可以直接加4力并且消耗不占抽位，信仰流那张加信仰的白卡呢？同样是在攻击卡之后打出，人家力量流能再加2力，即使不在攻击卡后边打出自己本身也加2力，你信仰流那张白卡(念珠)没有编织效果就只抽2，有编织了才加2信仰，而且还不消耗，等你发育起来力量流都杀完了 然后boss和小兵基本一个数值，为什么这么说？因为直到最后一章的boss，基本也就是两三个回合带走，第三章那个boss最搞笑，牌序好一回合就杀了，比普通战斗站位分散的小兵耗时还少，直接上去愤怒一开，双倍伤害两刀就砍死(观者打过来了？观者打过来了？别逗你观姐笑了，你观姐这一个角色的机制比这一个游戏的连招都丰富了) 总的来说也就图个新奇，有创新点但是很明显的玩法不足而且显然是没做完就端上来卖了，开局选男女我还以为选职业呢结果就选个性别给我气笑了。但是话又说回来了，如果最近不是绝地潜兵2又装死加上黑夜君临服务器卡得要死，又或者安东尼完全不当人，游戏荒了，没有种种机缘巧合的促使我也玩不到这款游戏，尽管它在给我提供的乐趣实在是太有限了，但是我还是要给它打上———————————— 差评😋 哎呀什么你说我怎么评测时才1.2个小时？因为我demo版还玩了4个小时，4个小时就能打一套毕业装备并且全2级强化，导致正式版出来，也就是第三章以后的内容我只花了1.2个小时就打完了，甚至还能退款，所以现在你明白这个游戏内容少到什么程度了吧？PS：开发者看到了可能会觉得不爽，但别学安东尼删测评哦，我的测评都有副本保存的，你已急哭XD 追加意见 看到开发者留言了有点意外，属于是打破我对安东尼式卡牌游戏开发者的成见了(对中文社区意见漠不关心，成天偷懒磨洋工，猴子打字机式平衡与更新)，我真心希望你们能够完成这款游戏的最终制作，因为在抽牌模式方面你们已经完胜杀戮尖塔2太多了 这里解释一下我为什么这么说 塔2的卡牌构建确实是走了rougelike的路线，但本质上还是通过数轮选牌达成最终卡组的拼装，这里就会涉及到一个问题：有些卡如果要想收益最大化，那你牌组中牌的数量就必须尽量少，比如华丽收场；反之有些卡要求牌组中的卡牌数量尽量多，比如心灵震慑。但不管怎么讲，不论这些卡能发挥的效果(即强度)如何，要讨论这一切的大前提是你应该有足够的机会去打出它，否则一切都是空谈，而这一点ASHES一串字母游戏已经完胜太多了，所以我会觉得这游戏不太平衡，因为它不是通过战斗构建牌组，而是出击时使用局外搭配好的牌组，局内是有选牌塞牌和删牌环节，但是对于一个已经构建好的牌组来说影响甚微，好比我打塔2自选套牌选5张华丽收场开局，那我往后直接就可以不拿牌也不删牌，说到这里大伙可能已经明白了我的意思，这也是导致这款游戏比较简单的原因。 其实写到这里我可以合理怀疑在局外构筑卡组并取消局内听牌环节是否就是开发组的本意，这和我之前玩过的一款手游，我忘记了它的英文原名叫什么名字，只记得中文译名叫红蔷薇之影，也是通过局外构筑卡组进行游戏，但红蔷薇之影的数值平衡就远胜ASHES一串字母游戏了，从而达成了在难度与趣味上的调和，并且它的结局也很有意思，我不知道是否是因为AI翻译的原因，在我看来ASHES一串字母游戏的结局完全就是谜语人，人称混乱，词不达意，感觉是要讲述一番苦大仇深的曲折故事，但机翻出来只让人感觉在听神棍讲民科 还有之前我提到的魂游加点式增幅攻击牌的攻击力，既然威能和信仰可以增幅，那敏捷和护甲也可以被算作增幅加成数啊，塔2还有根据护甲值决定攻击力的全身撞击呢。但要这样计算，我觉得就应该把威能/信仰/敏捷/护甲这四个根据装备增减的属性单独划分出来，因为我发现神醒者的升级，他的经验值似乎只是用来解锁连招的，除此之外根本毫无用处，那为什么不能升一级给几个万用点让玩家自行分配属性呢，就像魂游升级一样，这等级设定能提供的功能不就多起来了吗？而且既然装备强度与稀有度关系不大，盗墓套强得能够给传说等级了还只是个第三章就能刷出来的稀有装备(因为demo版只能玩到第三章，我就是demo版刷出来的)，那不如干脆取消掉大部分稀有度设定，让装备根据玩家的属性加点提供所契合的强度，这样开局选人界面也能做进一步更新，比如多做几个可选角色，他们初始点数的分配和装备都不同，出身也不同，背景故事也不同(这不就是艾尔登法环吗？是的没错但我说中国有句古话叫做好的文章都在讲同一件事，不怕你不缝，就怕你缝合得不够好，这样死了掉魂也显得合情合理(并不)），这游戏性和细节不一下就上来了么，我说制作组，大啖食粮之时已到有没有懂的 另外这个游戏的战斗，角色与怪物的攻击和移动，给我一种博德之门3的感觉，也是通过区分行动和进攻来组建完整的回合，刚玩上我就觉得在哪里见过这种模式，最后一想原来是博德之门3 其余没什么说的了，用AI就用AI吧，虽然有点膈应人，但三A大作(AI美术 AI代码 AI音乐)总有一天终将来临，ASHES也算是开路者了，只要能留下好的经验，那就像33号远征队里古斯塔夫说的：“for those who come after.” PS：这里用乔治.奥威尔所著的《1984》中“新话”的方式来向制作组解释一下本篇评测中的中文网络俚语，以在本文中出现的次序解释： 鬼抽———双加不好的抽牌 拉成啥了/拉完了———双加不好(double plus ungood) 请输入文本————双加强力(？！强强！？) 希望制作组能再次看到，也不枉我写这么久
The game has a neat system where you use cards to move around the map and to do attacks so you are always thinking both about positioning and using your deck correctly

A bit of roguelike action, turn based tactical combat and deckbuilding? With two decks? Sounds intriguing! After going through the tutorial and a bit of learning curve, the gameplay feels really smooth. Weaving and comboing cards comes instinctively and I feel that there's room for a lot of depth in creating decks. The art style is beautiful and haunting at the same time. It really gives me chills! Sparsely given scraps of lore build the mysterious and aerie atmosphere of Ashes of Morgravia. I have a lot of questions in my mind and can't wait to find out more about game's world. Great game, give it a go!

Enjoyable turn-based game with some clever mechanics. Two decks and combos allow for some explosive interactions early on, without delaying the "fun part" of deck building from a new player. Faith/aoe character does a really nice job evaporating hordes of enemies. Animated cards are cherry on top 🔥 Can recommend 👍🏻

It’s a fresh take on the card game genre, with great artwork, storytelling and animations that create an immersive atmosphere. Although the gameplay seems complicated at first, everything becomes clearer over time, and it’s enjoyable to defeat one opponent after another. It's definitely worth checking out!

looks pretty simple at first, but the combat has way more depth than I expected. The animated cards are really nice to look at too

Disclaimer: Yes AI was used in this game and the developer openly admits this. They are clearly a small team and they used AI to assist in making the game. This is the good way of using AI. They didn't fire anybody to replace them with a computer and as far as I can tell they didn't steal any art but used AI to refine theirs. I might be wrong, I'm no expert but at least in my opinion this isn't slop. A short but fun experience. For the price I'd recommend it. It could use Ascensions similar to Slay the Spire as the experience is relatively short and it's easy to beat the whole game without finishing even a single equipment set. The starting boon is incredibly powerful and it lends itself to bursting down the entire encounter in a single turn. The implementation of the enemy buff Revelation reduces all damage you deal to that enemy to 1 and in certain elite fights give an enemy this so you can't burst the encounter down. This is good but perhaps if Ascensions are implemented they could increase the stats of enemies in some way such as increased hp or even starting them with block so that you can still interact with them instead of just not attack because all damage is reduced to 1. A bit buggy at the moment but still a fun game from a new developer who is clearly just getting their bearings. If they refine the game or do more games in the future I'll be keeping my eye on them.

Decent tactical deckbuilding RPG. The atmosphere is awesome, the graphics give spine shivers and some of the events make the immersion absolute. Well done! Yet I rarely play games for their atmosphere, also here I came for tactical combat and I wasn't disappointed. You are building 2-sided deck and each time you choose how many of each to draw. There are number of mechanics to choose from, you can try to build around several combos and you constantly update your gear to best fit your chosen strategy. The gear comes in sets too. Although there are not that many cards and different items/equipment I think it is just enough to have fun with the game. It is art in itself to make interesting tactical game with so little! If I had to rate this game, I would give 7/10, losing points for following: - too short (finished in 6 hours) - limited content (more of everything would really shine in this game) - the difficulty (it was relatively easy, I just breezed through all the scenarios without failure and a need to reestablish my deck strategy - or lets face it, Im just too genial to pick the right one from the start :D)

[h1]8848，双卡双待 [/h1] [h2]前言： [/h2] 设计很有特色的一款肉鸽爬塔游戏，游戏中有两套卡组需要我们使用，在战斗中也需要去平衡好两套卡的使用节奏。 [h2]游戏玩法：[/h2] 首先游戏是让我们进入一张地图，没有自主选择路线，而是会随机弹出各种事件让我们选，触发事件后就会进入接下来的战斗或者是其他效果。 [h2]战斗地图和移动力—— [/h2] 如果进入战斗，那我们就会进入一张由若干个正六边形组成的战斗地图中，场地上会在不同的位置出现几个敌人，我们有一个初始位置，然后开始轮流回合行动。 每个人的回合都会拥有一定数量的移动力，可以在地图上移动对应的格子数量。不一定要一下子用完移动力，也可以走几步打一下再走几步，灵活机动嘛！ [h2]步伐和交锋牌组——[/h2] 战斗时我们需要使用的是卡牌，当然最核心的机制就是游戏里的两套卡组——步伐和交锋，首先我们每个回合抽卡前可以先决定这一回合抽到的双卡组比例，比如抽5的话，是分配14还是23。 这两套卡组中，其中步伐卡牌主要的重点是防御、移动、给自己上buff。比如说步伐种类中的位移卡牌，可以辅助移动一定的格子，然后还有防御可以给自己上一个护盾（敌人会优先打护盾），同时还可以增加护盾的增加量（类似于加了一点灵巧） 而交锋卡的特色就是攻击，基本都是以伤害为主，也有个对方上debuff的卡。 [h2]信仰、亵渎、灼烧—— [/h2] 游戏里有三种主要的额外伤害，分别是信仰、亵渎、灼烧，基本绑定的都是交锋卡牌。信仰可以从信仰值获得额外加成伤害，亵渎可以从威能值获得额外加成伤害 [h2]连招——[/h2] 每张卡都有一些对应的属性，一张卡可以拥有很多个属性，比如说近战、远程、神圣等等，而在连招表里面会有一个对应的连招顺序，当我们按照顺序使用卡牌时，就可以触发额外效果，给下一张牌提供一个很不错的额外效果。 [h2]交替使用的额外效果【编制】——[/h2] 部分卡牌会自带一个额外的编制效果，要想它生效的条件是上一张使用的卡牌是另一牌组。 当我们轮流使用步伐卡和交锋卡时，就会触发下一张的编制效果。 [h2]bug： [/h2] 文本似乎在有些地方汉化没有放进去，比如连招的torment字样，应该是折磨卡，但是没有显示汉字。 [h2]游玩感想：[/h2] 游戏里的卡牌虽然不多，但是属性和组合确实很有意思，两套卡组的设计再加上每回合行动力的机制，让人玩起来的时候不由得需要注意很多东西，比如说这一回合是打完跑远一点，还是利用掩体躲一下，亦或者是直接打完一个打第二个。 但是问题也是存在的，由于地图给的基本都不大，我方和敌人的移动力差距其实也差不多，所以实际上的移动就实际上变成了换个地方打架罢了。 [h2]总结： [/h2] 《Ashes of Morgravia》是一款肉鸽卡牌游戏，每次出战地图都会跳出来一些事件让我们来选择，有些会进入战斗，有些会提供休息或者是额外效果。游戏的特色是战斗中使用的卡牌有两套不同的卡组，每次回合前需要选择本次抽两套卡的比例，使用对应的卡还会产生连招效果，出现额外的加成伤害。战斗的地图是由若干个六边形组成的，双方在每回合还会拥有一定数量的移动力，平衡好两套卡组和移动力的使用非常关键。 [quote]关注「[url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/45531088] 鸢尾花 [/url]」[/quote] [u][b] 致那一朵未至鸢尾花 [/b][/u]
Quite short, but very well done with excellent game design. Looking forward to seeing what else this dev comes out with.

[h1]黑暗世界之战——《Ashes of Morgravia》[/h1] 在《Ashes of Morgravia》的世界中，你将扮演一位神觉者，直面各类恐怖生物。 游戏巧妙的将卡牌及战斗移动相结合，每回合，玩家可以自行选择移动/行动点数。 在你需要躲避时，点满移动战斗，在你需要打出伤害时，点满行动点数。一切随机应变。 就战斗而言，一方面，玩家可以利用初始卡牌，打出不错的伤害。 另一方面，随着击败怪物或者等级提升，玩家同样可以选择全新卡牌，来完善卡组。 在打出高额伤害的同时，你仍需要实时增加护甲，确保自己不被敌人的伤害击败。 而游戏中，有趣的装备系统，可以为玩家带来质的提升。 怎么说呢？就体验下来，游戏的剧情动画，做的还算不错，将了一个完整的故事。 但是在战斗环境，就感觉有点稍微草率，每个角色都在六边形中，特别不是特别鲜明。 立绘如果能更好一点就非常不错了。 而游玩过程中，玩家其实需要熟悉的内容，在教程中很详细的列举出来了。 这点做的还蛮不错的。当玩家熟悉后，就可以自行搭配卡牌，进行尝试了。 整体体验下来，游戏难度尚可，研究清楚一个套路，其实打起来还是挺轻松的。 但是，打完后，让玩家觉得没有再次挑战的意向，我觉得这个是需要加以完善的。 [quote]关注「[url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/45531088] 鸢尾花 [/url]」[/quote] [u][b] 致那一朵未至鸢尾花 [/b][/u]

I was actually surprised by Ashes of Morgravia. It is not a perfect game, and I can understand some of the complaints in other reviews, but for me the good parts are stronger than the bad ones. The main thing I liked is the combat. It is not just another card game where you only pick attack or block. The hex map, movement cards, and positioning make fights more interesting. You have to think where you stand, what enemies can reach you, and how to use your cards together. The dual deck idea is also cool, because you can control a bit what kind of cards you draw instead of praying to RNG all the time. What I liked even more is the Weave mechanic, which rewards you for using both of those decks. It might be a bit OP right now, which takes me to the next step. Some people say the game is not balanced, and yeah, sometimes you can make a build that becomes very strong. But honestly, for me that was part of the fun. I like when a deckbuilder lets me "break" the game a little - and I admit, sometimes it's a bit more than a little. I saw the devs in the discussion actively talking about the balancing and fixing other issues, so I hope this will be fine-tuned. Anyway, I did not feel like it ruined the experience. About the AI art/music/voice stuff - I get why some people don't like it. But I think the game still has a strong mood and identity. The visuals are dark, weird, and pretty unique. It doesn't look like every other fantasy indie game, and the animated cards/story scenes give it a nice atmosphere. There are also some rough edges. Some translations or lines feel a bit strange, but this feels more like a small indie game that is still growing, not some lazy cash grab. You can see there is an actual idea here. For me, Ashes of Morgravia is easy to recommend if you like tactical deckbuilders and dark fantasy. It needs polish, yes, but it also has much more character than many "cleaner" games. I would rather play something a bit rough but interesting than something perfectly safe and boring.

I liked the core element of drawing from two decks, ensuring a mix of support/buff and damage-dealing cards in my hand. The itemization mechanics also worked reasonably well, as it was fun to upgrade gear and complete item sets. A playthrough took about 5 hours to complete, with my only defeat being the forced fatality in the tutorial. The game is quite easy once you grasp the essentials (oddly, the most important mechanic (Weave) is not well signposted to the player, although it can be understood from the tool tips). There was one boss I killed so quickly that I never figured out what he was trying to do (building some sort of resource, but to what purpose I never saw as he died before he ever spent it). My other comment is that the card pool is extremely shallow (50 or fewer cards) and very few of the new cards are worth anything (other than Cleansing Fire). While every deckbuilder has its dud cards, almost every card on offer is inferior to what you start with, meaning that there is little joy in discovery when you are offered new cards. But this mattered less to me because of the short playing time and the deeper itemization pool. I'm giving the game a positive review because it wasn't a bad price at launch and I enjoyed the gameplay and the aesthetics but it may not be for everyone.

The game can be completed in about three to five hours. On top of that, it's very easy and offers little to no challenge. The AI is simply bad. What is especially frustrating is that you can't keep your progress after making the final choices that determine the ending. You don't receive the rewards or experience (XP) you've earned. For such a short and easy experience, I think the price is simply too high.
